name: before-after-contrast
title: Before / After
description: A balanced comparison frame for showing a meaningful change without a complex slider setup.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may refine the comparison copy or add a small annotation. Use a custom composition only when real imagery or a multi-axis comparison is required.

variables.label: Title
variables.default: See the difference in one frame

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

useWhen: Compare two states of the same subject on the same criterion.
avoidWhen: Do not show unrelated subjects as before/after or claim an unmeasured improvement.

inputRules.title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.before: Supply real before within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.after: Supply real after within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.takeaway: Supply real takeaway within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

cueBindings.before: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Establish the original state. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.after: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal the changed state. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.takeaway: When the corresponding narration clause begins: State the bounded difference. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

values.title: 同一个场地，不同的晚间使用方式
values.takeaway: 这是方案对照，不是实测效果

example.narration: 同一个场地，原来傍晚关闭，方案提出按安排开放夜校。这还不是实测效果。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Identify the common subject → Read the former state → Reveal the changed state → Read the bounded takeaway. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
